summary: Cycurion, Inc. filed an 8-K (Items 8.01 and 9.01) furnishing two press releases dated October 13 and 14, 2026, the first being an investor-awareness interview with CEO L. Kevin Kelly discussing the company's largest-ever contract award — a 10-year, $54.6 million engagement secured through a global consulting firm to modernize and secure client systems. The filing contains no transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or deal mechanics. It is an ordinary current report on business developments, not a special situation; watch for contract execution and revenue recognition, not arbitrage.
